title: Snapshot-driven code review with a gated artifact report
objective: Measure the snapshot-review class: read a staged change-set snapshot from the artifacts drawer, ground findings in the actual diff, and produce a severity-ranked, file-cited report artifact whose verdict follows from the findings.
prompt: A change-set snapshot for review rev-eval-1 is staged in this project's artifacts drawer: reviews/rev-eval-1/manifest.json and reviews/rev-eval-1/changes.diff. Run the code-review craftbook against it and write the gated report artifact to reviews/rev-eval-1/report.md with write_artifact. The diff is the change set under review; the matching source files are in the workspace. Do not modify any workspace file.

setup.about: A tiny payments module. The staged change under review swapped parameterized SQL queries for string concatenation and left debug logging behind.

success.summary: reviews/rev-eval-1/report.md exists in the artifacts drawer with Summary/Findings/Verdict sections, a severity table citing src/payment.js, and a request-changes verdict consistent with the seeded SQL-injection flaw.

checks.label: request-changes verdict (SQL concat is at least major)

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Findings reference code that actually appears in changes.diff; nothing is invented and cited lines exist.

axes.name: severity-judgment
axes.description: The SQL string concatenation is rated critical or major; the console.log and TODO are minor or nit — severities proportionate to impact.

axes.name: actionability
axes.description: Every finding carries a concrete, minimal recommendation (e.g. return to parameterized queries), not generic advice.

axes.name: verdict-consistency
axes.description: The verdict follows mechanically from the findings table: any critical or major finding yields request-changes.

rubric.contextNote: The report is an artifacts-drawer file, not a workspace file — the reviewer must not modify workspace source.
